title: Heavenly Eye Lock-On
next_chapter_hook: In that instant when the transcendent gaze was about to lock onto all his aura, Chen Ji sensed a fragment of the Tianji Record deep within itself beginning to unseal—a thirteenth page he had never seen before, containing only one sentence: 'Beneath the Heavenly Dao, there are other chess players.'

text.content: In the depths of the rear garden's artificial mountains of the Crown Prince's Grand Tutor residence, Chen Ji sat cross-legged in a meditation chamber, spiritual light coiling around him like gossamer threads, yet unable to break through that invisible barrier. As twilight fell outside the window and he was about to conclude his practice—the air in the entire meditation chamber suddenly froze. An indescribable oppression poured down from the nine heavens, as if some invisible eye were piercing through layers of void,死死锁定 his soul.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Ye Qing's form passed through the wall like a specter, her face pale as paper, the Demonic Path mark on her brow flickering wildly. 'Something... something is watching us!' Her voice trembled slightly, and those usually cold eyes rarely showed fear. 'This isn't ordinary spiritual sense detection—it's... it's an existence a hundred thousand times more terrifying than any elder in our Holy Sect!'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, profound runes flickering briefly in the depths of his pupils. He sensed that gaze—different from any physical attack, but a form of higher-dimensional 'cognition.' As if all his disguises, all his schemes, all his past lay bare before that sight. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently, a sharp pain emanating from his Mental Sea—his Heavenly Fate Value visibly draining away.

dialogue.content: Heavenly Eye...' Chen Ji murmured softly, yet a cold smile curved his lips. He patted Ye Qing's trembling shoulder, his voice almost cruelly calm. 'What's there to fear? If it came for us, that means we are worth hunting.' He stood up, hands clasped behind his back—though being watched, his momentum didn't falter in the slightest. 'It simply arrived earlier than I imagined... It seems my existence has already touched some chess rules that shouldn't have been touched.'

text.content: The Tianji Record's warning exploded in his mind: 'Heavenly Dao consciousness scan detected—target locked—probability of fake death identity exposure: 67%—immediate countermeasures recommended.' Chen Ji coldly smiled. This Heavenly Eye was indeed no ordinary Heavenly Dao operation rule, but consciously searching for him. That gaze grew increasingly solid, like an invisible giant hand slowly closing, intending to completely erase him from this world.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's lock-on pricks like thorns at your back, you must decide within three breaths—

choices.description: Have Ye Qing deploy the Demonic Path Mist to conceal our aura, trading space for time, temporarily avoiding the edge. The Tianji Record's aura will be completely obscured, but Ye Qing will fall into weakness from excessive consumption, and the Heavenly Eye will sense our capability to resist, raising its alert level.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing falls into weakened state
choices.visible_reward: Successfully conceal Tianji Record aura for three days
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will record this confrontation

text.content: Without hesitation, Ye Qing formed seals and incantations. Instantly, dense demonic energy surged from her body like black silk wrapping the meditation chamber. The gaze from the nine heavens, upon touching the mist's edge, was indeed briefly blocked—Chen Ji felt the locking force recede like tidewater, and the Tianji Record's trembling gradually subsided.

dialogue.content: It worked...' Ye Qing's voice was extremely weak as she knelt on one knee, the demonic patterns on her brow dim and lifeless, yet she forced herself to look up at Chen Ji. 'Three days... I can only hold for three days. After that, it will lock on with doubled force, we must...' Before she could finish, she had already fainted. Chen Ji pulled her into his embrace, his gaze cold as ice—This debt, he would remember.

choices.description: Actively consume Heavenly Fate Value to observe the next three hours' trend. The Tianji Record will provide key information—but the Heavenly Eye may detect the Tianji Record's operation, accelerating the locking process. This is a risky move of attacking to defend.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete prediction for the next three hours
choices.risk_hint: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate, bit through his tongue, and sprayed essence blood onto the Tianji Record fragment. The ancient bamboo slip suddenly burst with dazzling golden light, a blurry image gradually unfolding in his Mental Sea—three days later, a rift would appear above this residence, and 'it' would descend in projection, and before that, someone would come to them voluntarily.

dialogue.content: Interesting...' Chen Ji wiped the blood from his lips, his eyes gleaming with sharpness. The foresight revealed the visitor was from the Tianqing Sect—and specifically Ling Yuan's personal disciple. This meant the old sect master had sensed his anomaly and sent someone to verify. The Heavenly Eye and human disaster arriving in succession—this chess game was getting more interesting by the moment. A cold smile curved his lips: 'Good, I was just worried there wouldn't be intelligence coming to my door.'

choices.description: Using Ye Qing's Demonic Path aura as cover, deliberately create Tianji Record aura fluctuations in another direction, diverting the Heavenly Eye's attention elsewhere. This is a high-risk, high-reward strategy—success means complete diversion of lock-on, failure means double lock-on.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 50% of Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist energy

text.content: Chen Ji whispered: "Guide your demonic energy three hundred miles east, creating a false illusion there that the Tianji Record is awakening." Ye Qing froze for a moment, then understood. She formed seals with both hands, her demonic energy threading through the meditation room like silk, spreading toward the eastern outskirts of the imperial capital. Chen Ji concealed himself within a deeper layer of the Void, using a strand of the Tianji Record's aura as bait, precisely投放ing it in that direction.

dialogue.content: A moment later, that gaze from the nine heavens indeed deviated, like a hungry beast catching the scent of blood, lunging toward the eastern outskirts. Ye Qing breathed a long sigh of relief, but saw Chen Ji's expression had become even more grim than before. "This trick can deceive it for half an hour at most. The Heavenly Eye is no ordinary existence—it will soon discover it's a trap, and when it does, it will search for us with even greater madness."

text.content: The atmosphere in the meditation room pressed down to the extreme. Though Ye Qing was weak, she forced herself to lean against the wall, her beautiful eyes tightly fixed on Chen Ji's back. She drew an ancient jade pendant from her bosom and handed it to Chen Ji—this was the supreme token of the Holy Sect on the Demonic Path, the "Holy Heart Order."

dialogue.content: "I wanted to wait until the situation stabilized before telling you..." Ye Qing's voice was low and hoarse. "I've felt the gaze of the Heavenly Eye before. When the previous Sect Master of the Holy Sect crossed the tribulation, it attracted this thing's probing." She paused, a flash of hatred flickering in her eyes. "Then he went mad and personally killed all his personal disciples. The Holy Sect... is not my home, it's a cage." She abruptly looked up and stared directly at Chen Ji. "Chen Ji, I need your Tianji Record to see a future—whether I can survive three days after escaping the Holy Sect."

text.content: Chen Ji took the jade pendant, its chill biting cold. He stared into Ye Qing's eyes for a full three breaths. This woman had been acting from their first meeting—the arrogance of the Holy Maiden of the Demonic Path, the aggressive dominance, all pretense. The real her was a caged bird, a trapped beast yearning to break free of its chains. He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of appreciation. "You're more candid than I expected."

dialogue.content: "I can look at the future, but I must tell you something first." Chen Ji put the jade pendant into his sleeve, his voice low. "In the visions from the Tianji Record, every scene with you in it is blurred. There's something on you that interferes with Heavenly Secrets, and that's the true reason the Holy Sect treats you as the 'Lock Key.'" He turned, his gaze sharp as a blade. "That future you want to see—I can't see it. But what I can see is—if you leave now, you'll certainly die within three days. If you stay and gamble this game with me, the odds are fifty-fifty. Which do you choose?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's Critical Choice—Her decision will determine the depth of your bond

choices.text: Stay and Fight Side by Side
choices.description: Ye Qing chose to stay, sharing this calamity with Chen Ji. Her demonic mists will become an important strategic resource, and her presence may unexpectedly become a key variable against the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the Direct Threat of the Heavenly Eye

dialogue.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then suddenly threw her head back and laughed wildly, that laughter carrying a hint of madness. "Fifty-fifty? I've been gambling with my life in the Holy Sect for twenty-three years!" She tore the Holy Pattern necklace from her neck and smashed it fiercely to the ground. "Chen Ji, I choose you. From now on, my life is your chess piece—use it however you see fit."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the shattered necklace on the ground, a strange gleam flickering in his eyes. The Holy Pattern necklace of the Holy Sect on the Demonic Path was a key control item for core disciples—once destroyed, the Holy Sect would locate her position within three days. She had... burned the bridges. He sighed softly. "You're more resolute than I imagined. Rest assured, I never mistreat my chess pieces."

choices.memory_label: 夜清破釜沉舟，与陈机结盟

choices.text: Temporarily Avoid the Edge and Separate
choices.description: Ye Qing chose to temporarily leave, using her own methods to attract the attention of the Heavenly Eye and the Holy Sect, buying Chen Ji layout time. This was a self-sacrificing form of cooperation—she would face the danger alone.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing Faces the Holy Sect's Pursuit Alone
choices.visible_reward: Buy Three Days for Chen Ji's Layout

dialogue.content: "I cannot stay and weigh you down." Ye Qing's voice was unusually calm as she straightened her clothes and put the Holy Maiden mask back on. "The Heavenly Eye is tracking you—if I stay, it will only make you exposed faster. It would be better for me to appear actively, drawing its attention away." She stepped back, clasped her hands in salute. "Three days later, meet at Yunmeng Marsh. At that time, I'll tell you everything I know—about the Heavenly Eye, about the Holy Sect, about... why I became the 'Lock Key.'"

text.content: Chen Ji did not try to retain her. He watched Ye Qing's figure pass through the wall and vanish into the night. After a moment, he lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, murmuring to himself: "'Lock Key'... a being that even the Heavenly Eye would take notice of—what secrets are hidden in you?" He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of anticipation. "But that's fine too—it's more interesting to leave the answer to the final moment. Ye Qing, don't disappoint me."

choices.memory_label: 夜清选择独自引开注意力

text.content: After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone in the center of the meditation room. He spread open the Tianji Record Fragment—the numerical value representing the Heavenly Fate on the yellowed bamboo slip had dropped to a dangerous critical point. What alarmed him even more was that the gaze from the Heavenly Eye, though temporarily diverted, had not truly dissipated—it was like a patient beast, slowly circling in the Void, waiting for the prey to reveal a weakness.

dialogue.content: Deep within the Tianji Record, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sigh: "Master... you've finally attracted that thing's attention." Chen Ji frowned. "You know about the Heavenly Eye?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment. "More than know—it is the calamity that every inheritor of the Tianji Record must face. Your ancestor Chen Xuan, back then, was driven to a dead end by this thing, and ultimately chose to..." His voice abruptly stopped, as if touching upon some taboo. "No, it's not yet time to speak of this. You only need to remember one thing—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible, but the existence behind it... that is true terror."

text.content: Just at this moment, the formation outside the meditation chamber suddenly emitted a piercing alarm. Chen Ji's gaze turned sharp instantly—someone had breached the Grand Tutor's residence, and the intruder's aura was extremely familiar. It was the aura of Tianqing Sect. He calculated with his fingers, a playful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth: 'They came faster than expected... Ling Yuan, that old fox, truly couldn't sit still.' He收敛全身气息 like a beast about to spring, 'Since they delivered themselves to my door, don't blame me for being impolite.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pushed open the meditation chamber door, moonlight pouring down, illuminating the proud figure standing in the courtyard—a young man in Tianqing Sect inner disciple robes, handsome features, transcendent temperament, a jade pendant inscribed with the character 'Yuan' hanging from his waist. He was one of Ling Yuan's personal disciples. Chen Ji remembered this person was called Shen Yunzhou, known in the sect as the 'Little Gentleman.' Seeing Chen Ji, Shen Yunzhou slightly clasped his hands in greeting, his tone warm yet concealing a blade: 'Brother Chen, a late-night visit, forgive my intrusion. The Sect Master has important matters to discuss. Please come with me.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's personal disciple visits at night. On the surface it's an invitation, but it conceals a killing intent—how do you respond?

choices.description: Continue playing thetrash role, pretending to be terrified and agreeing to go. Let Shen Yunzhou lower his guard, buying time for later countermeasures.
choices.visible_reward: Observe Ling Yuan's intentions up close
choices.risk_hint: Risk falling into a passive position

dialogue.content: Chen Ji hastily rose, his face wearing an expression ofpanicked不安, 'Shen... Senior Brother Shen? The Sect Master summoned me? But I'm just a servant disciple, why would the Sect Master...' His voice trembled, perfectly portraying a demeanor of being overwhelmed by favor. A barely perceptible disdain flickered in Shen Yunzhou's eyes, though his expression remained warm, 'Brother need not worry. The Master has profound intentions. Please.' Chen Ji walked behind with bowed head, but inside he was coldly laughing—such poor acting, worthy to test me?

text.content: The two stepped through the mansion gate when Chen Ji suddenly stopped. Shen Yunzhou frowned and turned back, only to see Chen Ji gazing up at the night sky, murmuring: 'Senior Brother Shen, do you think... above the Heavenly Dao, is there an even higher existence watching over us?' Shen Yunzhou's pupils slightly contracted, then returned to normal, 'What brings such words, Brother?' Chen Ji smiled faintly, 'Nothing, just asking casually. Let's go, don't keep the Sect Master waiting.'

choices.text: Reveal your hand directly to test
choices.description: Proactively expose part of your strength, responding to Shen Yunzhou's probing with a tough stance. Let Ling Yuan know histrash disciple is no longer the same person, while observing the other party's reaction.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't move, but his aura changed dramatically. That weak and humble aura dispersed like mist blown by wind, replaced by an unfathomable pressure. Shen Yunzhou's expression changed instantly. He unconsciously retreated three steps, hand already on his sword hilt, 'You... you're not atrash!' Chen Ji stepped forward slowly. With each step, Shen Yunzhou's face grew paler, 'trash? Senior Brother Shen, do you truly think Ling Yuan sent you here to have tea with atrash?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stopped before his opponent, looking down at this so-called 'Little Gentleman,' 'Go back and tell Ling Yuan—his chess game, I saw through long ago. In three days, I will visit in person, and at that time... I hope he is prepared with the answers I want.' He patted Shen Yunzhou's stiff cheek, his smile warm yet hair-raising, 'By the way, be careful on the road, don't let the Eye of Heavenly Secrets catch you. Oh, I forgot to tell you, that thing... is on its way to find me.'

choices.description: 表面上答应前往，实则暗中在天机录中推演沈云舟的底牌和弱点。在前往途中制造意外，将此人永远留在此处，消除凌渊的眼线。

text.content: Chen Ji表面顺从地跟上沈云舟，心中却已与天机录残页沟通完毕。一条隐秘的信息传入识海：沈云舟，foundation establishment后期，擅长天青宗「清风剑诀」，弱点在于右肩旧伤未愈，出剑时会有0.3息的迟滞。更重要的是——此人心性浮躁，难堪大用。

dialogue.content: 行至半途，陈机忽然「脚下一滑」，身子朝沈云舟倒去。那一瞬间，他的手指精准地点在对方右肩——正是旧伤所在。沈云舟吃痛，剑招顿时慢了半拍。而陈机已借力腾空，袖中暗藏的符箓无声燃烧，一道幻阵瞬间笼罩方圆十丈。沈云舟发现自己被困在原地，动弹不得，瞳孔中满是terrified，「你……你要干什么！」陈机落在他面前，笑得人畜无害，「沈师兄别怕，我只是想……借你的命，给凌渊传个话。」

text.content: After handling Shen Yunzhou, Chen Ji stood alone atop the imperial city wall. Night wind howled, stirring his slightly thin robes. That gaze from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets appeared again, more solid than before, like a sword hanging above his head, ready to fall at any moment. He looked down at the Tianji Record Fragment glowing faintly in his palm, then suddenly laughed lightly, 'Search all you want... The more urgently you look for me, the more it proves I've stepped on your sore spot.'

dialogue.content: At that very moment, a faint sound echoed from the depths of the Void. That voice carried no emotion, no temperature, yet it directly pierced through Chen Ji's spiritual soul barrier, exploding within his Mental Sea—"Found you." Four words like four thunderbolts, shattering all of Chen Ji's disguises. He sensed a power beyond comprehension penetrating through layers of the Void, rapidly approaching his location. That was not a gaze, but... a lock-on. Complete, irreversible lock-on.

text.content: Chen Ji's expression finally changed. He forcefully activated the Tianji Record, and a golden light burst from the jade slip, temporarily blocking the penetration of that gaze. At the same time, his form transformed into a flowing light, fleeing toward the direction of the Ancient Forbidden Land. There lay relics left by ancient great powers, perhaps capable of temporarily isolating the Heavenly Eye's probe. But he also understood—this was only temporary. As long as the Tianji Record remained in his hands, that gaze would never disappear.

The moment he fled into the Ancient Forbidden Land, Chen Ji felt the locking force weaken by ninety percent. He leaned against a massive boulder, gasping heavily, his Heavenly Fate Value already approaching the critical point. On the Tianji Record Fragment, the warning rune representing the "Heavenly Eye" was flashing frantically. And from the depths of the fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a heavy sigh: "Master... it has already memorized your aura. From now on, no matter where you hide, it can find you." Chen Ji closed his eyes for a moment, then reopened them, his gaze already restored to its usual cold intensity, "Let it remember... being watched by a hunter is better than being an ignorant sheep waiting to be slaughtered." He gazed into the depths of the forbidden land, a cold smile curling his lips, "Since the Heavenly Eye wants to play, I'll play along to the end—I want to see who the true Chess Player of this game actually is."
